newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia STM to buy stake in TV station.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia STM to buy stake in TV station.

text.p: Malaysia's private television station, Sistem Televisyen Malaysia Bhd, or TV3, said on Friday it has agreed to acquire a 49 percent stake in Sistem Network Nusantara Sdn Bhd for 49,001 ringgit.

TV3 said in a statement that Sistem Network Nusantara has been granted approval by the Malaysian government to set up and operate a Malay language television channel for broadcast within the Southeast Asia region.
The stake will be acquired from Abdul Ghani Yusof who will retain a 51 percent shareholding in Sistem Network Nusantara.
